Inside sunwoojunga’s “Run with Me”

A trip taken alone became an offer to go together. The story behind “도망가자”, and the expectations that followed it onto the stage.

BY indiek / 2026-10-20

Before “Run with Me” was an offer of company, sunwoojunga had tried leaving alone. In a YouTube appearance reported by SBS in January 2023, she recalled an argument early in her marriage. She left in her nightclothes, taking an acoustic guitar, and ended up in Gangwon Province. Her husband came to collect her. [1]

By the time she wrote the song, he was having a difficult time. Remembering her own departure, she wanted to take him away and stay beside him. In her account, the person whose husband once collected her now offers to accompany him. [1]

“Run with Me” appears on Serenade, released on 12 December 2019. [3]

An invitation, and an expectation

The song’s success also changed how she approached performing it. Speaking to Angelica Vianello for The Kraze in 2024, sunwoojunga said she had not expected the success of “Run with Me” and Serenade. It made her reconsider her relationship with ballads, having worked across several genres. [2]

She told Vianello that audience expectations made her nervous before performing it, even as she welcomed its reception. The song had become a source of happiness and something to live up to. [2]

Read together, the two accounts suggest a change in the scale of the offer. What began as a wish to accompany her husband now had to meet the expectations of a room. Her gratitude and her nervousness leave both sides of that exchange visible: the company she offered, and the demands that came with being heard. [1] [2]
